QA verdict: NEEDS FIXES (Iteration 1). Full report: /Users/chenpeijue/.codebuddy/skills/jj-project/gen-jj-project/jj-type-mac/qa-report.md — read it IN FULL. Build claims independently reproduced by orchestrator (Debug+Release SUCCEEDED, see verify/build-iteration1.log).

Your disposition duty (references/feedback-loop-guide.md): verify EACH claim against the code first — fix what is right, refute what is wrong WITH EVIDENCE. Investigate root cause before fixing; no blind patching. Issues:

- **C1 [Critical]** Hotkey customization chain is broken: SettingsWindowController.handleHotkeyChange passes a non-nil action ID into AppDelegate's (HotkeyID?, Hotkey) callback whose semantics is "FAILED id, nil=success" → false "注册失败" alert every recording + return blocks reregisterHotkeys; store.translateHotkey/correctHotkey setters have ZERO call sites (dead code) → new hotkeys never persist/re-register. Fix per report suggestion: write via store setter → onHotkeyChanged → reregister with REAL conflict detection; remove/repurpose the misleading callback channel; keep recorder display in sync.
- **W1** HotkeyManager init discards reregister() result → startup conflicts silent. Move registration out of init; applicationDidFinishLaunching consumes the result and alerts on failure.
- **W2** No cross-validation: the two actions can be bound to identical combos. Validate against the other binding on record; reject with Chinese hint.
- **W3** KeychainStore.saveAPIKey swallows SecItemUpdate (non-NotFound) and SecItemAdd errors; UI shows 已保存 regardless. Restore throws (per plan §7) and surface failure in save flow.
- **N1** Spec deviation: plan §8 says deleting active provider CLEARS active; code auto-fills providers.first. Align with plan (clear active) unless you can justify escalation.
- **N2** CaptureError.accessibilityNotGranted has no throw site — add defensive check at capture entry or remove the case.
- **N3** Delete leftover empty jj-type/Base.lproj/ directory.
- **N4** Implement applicationSupportsSecureRestorableState -> true.

Performance suggestions (disposition each: OPTIMIZED / REFUTED with quantified evidence / DEFERRED): P2-1 table cell view reuse (cold path, QA leans REFUTE), P2-2 UCKeyTranslate per-call (cold path, QA leans REFUTE).

1. **S1**: showError on no-active-provider path must be VISIBLE — route through showLoading-style presentation (present panel + monitors) or present-before-error; ensure error state always shows the panel when it wasn't visible.
2. **S2** (=QA N6): HotkeyRecorderView.keyDown must NOT commit candidate to self.hotkey before validation; stash old value, apply only on accepted callback, reject() restores old display. Fix comment/implementation mismatch.
3. **S3**: NSPasteboard access must happen on main thread — restructure TextCaptureService: background timing/polling of a main-thread hop for changeCount/string reads (e.g. poll via MainActor DispatchQueue.main.async reads, or capture on main before/after). Keep bounded polling and no main-thread blocking.
4. **S4**: signing consistency per updated A6: keep DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=36RXHYW79N + Automatic/Apple Development; REMOVE the ad-hoc CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-" baseline and the [sdk=macosx*] override conflict; update AGENTS.md signing section to match reality (personal team, publish intent pending channel decision).
5. Notes N5-N13: fix the cheap/safe ones (N5 dead field translateToChinese + redundant switch; N6 unused params mode/sourceIsChinese in showResult — clean signature; N7 surface malformedResponse on decode failure instead of emptyResponse; N8 prompt must handle "other" languages in correctAndTranslate branch like translate mode does; N9 covered by item C below; N10 addProvider must NOT persist provider when Keychain save fails — order: keychain first, then persist, rollback on failure; updateProvider not-found returns false; N11 document or fix asymmetric reregister (prefer: keep all-or-nothing, but alert text should say BOTH hotkeys unregistered when second fails); N12 align AGENTS.md (shared static URLSession in AIClient; IUO policy — replace ! with lazy/strong where trivial); N13 add local mouse monitor so clicking our own windows dismisses panel + rename misleading locationInWindowCoords variable). Global keyDown monitor privacy note: keep (Esc while unfocused needs it) but document in AGENTS.md.

## B. App icon wiring (new requirement)
- icon_1024.png ALREADY generated at jj-type/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/icon_1024.png (1024 RGBA, CoreGraphics-rendered). Update that appiconset's Contents.json to macOS single-size ("images":[{"filename":"icon_1024.png","idiom":"mac","scale":"1x","size":"1024x1024"}] style — verify exact modern format for single-size). Ensure pbxproj has ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME=AppIcon (likely template default) and Info.plist does NOT need CFBundleIconFile (asset catalog suffices). Verify build succeeds and .app shows the icon (check Products/jj-type.app/Contents/Resources/AppIcon... or Assets.car presence).
- Menu bar status icon: use SF Symbol via NSImage(systemSymbolName:accessibilityDescription:) (e.g. "character.bubble" or "translate"), template rendering so it adapts to light/dark menu bar.

## C. Permission UX parity (new requirement — like mainstream apps)
- Primary: on missing permission use AXIsProcessTrustedWithOptions with kAXTrustedCheckOptionPrompt=true — the system's native dialog with a direct "Open System Settings" button (standard mainstream behavior). Use it at first-launch and at hotkey trigger when permission is missing.
- Guide window (keep as supplementary): NSApp.activate(ignoringOtherApps: true) before showWindow so it actually comes to front in LSUIElement app; modern System Settings URL for macOS 13+ (x-apple.systempreferences:com.apple.settings.PrivacySecurity.extension?Privacy_Accessibility — verify the correct modern constant; legacy URL as fallback).
- End-to-end: hotkey press without permission → native prompt/guide appears (NOT just a panel error).

## Constraints (unchanged)
Zero third-party deps; no git commit/push; English comments, Chinese UI; never touch mode.json/.codebuddy; performance-conscious.

## After implementation

Final batch before user manual acceptance. requirement.md now has "Second Post-Phase-4 Batch" — read it. Work items:

## 1. Hardening (QA It3 leftovers)
- `window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false` for BOTH programmatic windows (SettingsWindowController + AccessibilityGuideWindowController).
- N15: remove dead `TranslationTask.sourceIsChinese` accessor if truly dead after It3 (verify no consumers first) + remove unused `mode` param from `PromptBuilder.parse` (or use it meaningfully — your call, keep clean).

## 2. Mixed-language rule (NEW requirement, update LanguageRouter + PromptBuilder)
- Detection now 4-way: english / chinese / mixed / other.
- mixed (contains BOTH CJK and latin letters) → same behavior as chinese: skip correction, translate to English.
- Update prompts accordingly. Add/adjust unit-level reasoning in self-check (walk through each branch).

## 3. Prompt language decision (3.1 — your call, document it)
- Decide whether system/user prompts sent to the AI should be English instead of Chinese (typical: English instructions get broader model compliance, esp. for strict-JSON contracts). UI text stays Chinese. Record decision + rationale in result.md Iteration 4.

## 4. App display name = JJType
- Info.plist: CFBundleName=JJType, CFBundleDisplayName=JJType (keep bundle id/target name unchanged — avoid pbxproj churn). Status item tooltip if any shows JJType.

## 5. build-release.sh at repo ROOT (new file, executable)
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Builds Release .app and copies to apps/JJType-<timestamp>.app
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
APP_NAME="JJType-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M)"
xcodebuild -project jj-type.xcodeproj -scheme jj-type -configuration Release build -quiet
SRC=$(ls -d ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/jj-type-*/Build/Products/Release/*.app | head -1)
mkdir -p apps
rm -rf "apps/${APP_NAME}.app"
cp -R "$SRC" "apps/${APP_NAME}.app"
echo "✅ Built: apps/${APP_NAME}.app"
```
Refine as needed (e.g. use -derivedDataPath ./build for determinism — preferred, avoids DerivedData wildcard fragility; add build/ to .gitignore too). Create/append .gitignore with `apps/` and `build/` (note: repo has NO .gitignore yet — creating one is fine, it's repo hygiene for this script requirement; mention it in result.md).

## 6. Full verification
- Self-check 7a–7g; Debug + Release both green. Also RUN build-release.sh once yourself to prove it works and produces apps/JJType-*.app (then remove the produced timestamped copy so user's first run is clean? NO — leave it, it proves the flow; report the path).
- UPDATE result.md with "Iteration 4" section: items 1-5 incl. prompt-language decision + mixed-language branch walkthrough.
- Message main. QA It4 re-review follows. Keep all standing constraints (no commit/push, zero deps, English comments, Chinese UI, mode.json/.codebuddy untouched).

2. Re-run the script; verify with `lipo -archs` and `lipo -info` on the produced binary (build/Build/Products/Release/jj-type.app/Contents/MacOS/jj-type) that it reports "x86_64 arm64". Also confirm Debug still builds fine on your side (the ARCHS change should live only in the script invocation, not pbxproj — keep pbxproj untouched so Xcode dev flow stays native-arch-fast; universal only for release distribution).
3. Check our sources have zero arch-conditional code (they don't — pure Swift/AppKit/Carbon, both-arch safe; just confirm no #if arch() anywhere).
4. Also update AGENTS.md build commands section: note build-release.sh produces a universal binary.
5. UPDATE result.md — append a short "Iteration 5 (universal binary)" note: change, lipo evidence, no source changes.
6. Message main with the lipo output.

USER BLOCKER (manual acceptance): app launches (process alive, no crash reports) but the menu-bar status icon NEVER appears — both Xcode ⌘R and Finder double-click. Your acceptance test gate.

Evidence gathered by Orchestrator:
- Process runs fine (PID spawns via `open`), exit not happening
- `log show --predicate process=="jj-type"` → EMPTY (no breadcrumbs to tell if applicationDidFinishLaunching runs)
- Product Info.plist (Debug, DerivedData) has NO `NSPrincipalClass` — custom INFOPLIST_FILE merge does inject generated keys (CFBundleName/DisplayName present) but not NSPrincipalClass. Probably a red herring for Swift @main (runtime sets delegate directly) but unverified.
- No NSMainStoryboardFile or iOS keys in product plist; LSUIElement=true confirmed
- User machine: macOS 26 beta (25A362), Xcode 26.1 beta, SDK macosx26.1

TASK (root-cause debug discipline — three-strike applies):
1. Add temporary breadcrumbs (os_log/nslog) at: applicationDidFinishLaunching entry, statusItem creation, configureStatusIcon result (which branch: symbol loaded? image size?), rebuildStatusMenu entry, and hotkey registration result.
2. Launch the built app headlessly via `open` (same GUI session), then read `log show --last 1m --predicate process=="jj-type"` to capture the trail. Determine: does didFinishLaunching run? Is the image nil? Is button zero-size? Is statusItem visibleLength OK? etc.
3. Known suspects to check while at it: (a) NSImage(systemSymbolName:) on macOS 26 beta — verify non-nil + setSize; consider explicit `button.imageScaling` and preferredSymbolConfiguration; (b) squareLength + missing content; (c) add NSPrincipalClass=NSApplication to source Info.plist as standard AppKit hygiene (harmless, likely not the root cause); (d) if breadcrumbs show didFinishLaunching NOT running — investigate @main wiring (e.g., leftover scene manifest handling, INFOPLIST_KEY_UIApplicationSceneManifest generation) and fix properly.
4. Fix root cause, REMOVE breadcrumbs (or convert to a single os_signpoint if valuable), rebuild both configs, and VERIFY the icon appears by launching via `open` — verification method: `lsappinfo` / accessibility dump if possible, or add a one-shot debug `button.title` text fallback so even a missing symbol shows visible text. Make the icon bulletproof: if symbol image is nil OR its size is zero → set button.title = "文A" ALWAYS as final fallback.
5. Self-check 7a–7g, both builds green, update result.md "Iteration 6 (status icon not visible — root cause + fix)", message main with the ROOT CAUSE and evidence trail.

USER CONFIRMED: icon STILL missing after ⌘R with your NSPrincipalClass fix built in (product plist verified NSApplication present at build time). Strike 2 on this issue — root-cause it FOR REAL this time with runtime evidence. Do the diagnosis in YOUR session.

## Evidence trail (Orchestrator's findings — important corrections)
1. **My "empty 58KB binary" alarm was WRONG**: Xcode 26 Debug uses stub+dylib architecture — 58KB `jj-type` stub + 927KB `jj-type.debug.dylib` (contains code) + `__preview.dylib`. Release (build/) = 971KB real binary. Nothing was ever missing from builds.
2. `log show` cannot see your `Logger.info` breadcrumbs — info-level is memory-only, not persisted. That's why all log queries were empty. Do NOT rely on `log show`.
3. User REJECTED a backgrounded `log stream ... &` command earlier — avoid backgrounded/long-running processes. Use `log collect --last 2m --output /tmp/jj.logarchive` + `log show /tmp/jj.logarchive --info --debug --predicate 'subsystem == "com.aigens.jj-type"'` OR, most robust: **file-based breadcrumbs** (append lines to ~/jj-debug.log via FileManager at each lifecycle point) — zero dependence on the logging system.
4. Process stays alive after launch (no crash) — on this macOS 26 beta (25A362) + Xcode 26.1 beta.

## Diagnostic plan (adapt as evidence dictates)
1. Add file breadcrumbs at: @main/AppDelegate.init, applicationDidFinishLaunching ENTRY, statusItem created, configureStatusIcon branch + image size, rebuildStatusMenu count, reregister result, didFinishLaunching END.
2. Launch the built app (open .../Debug/jj-type.app — or ask user to ⌘R if your launch gets rejected). Read ~/jj-debug.log. This answers THE question: does the delegate lifecycle run at all?
3. Branch A (file shows ENTRY+END but no icon): the delegate runs; the status item itself is the problem on macOS 26 beta. Investigate: button content (image vs title), squareLength vs variableLength, NSStatusBar behavior changes, try setting BOTH image AND title, try `statusItem.isVisible = true`, test variableLength, check `statusItem.button?.window` ordering. Consider macOS 26 Liquid Glass menu bar rendering of template symbols — test with `symbol.isTemplate = false` + monochrome.
4. Branch B (file EMPTY — delegate never runs): the @main bootstrap is broken despite NSPrincipalClass. Investigate: does the stub load debug.dylib at all (add breadcrumb in AppDelegate.init); try replacing @main with an explicit `main.swift` (NSApplication.shared + delegate + run) — bypasses bootstrap entirely and is decisive; check linker `-alias _main ___debug_main_executable_dylib_entry_point` behavior when launched via `open` vs Xcode.
5. Fix root cause, keep breadcrumbs until user confirms icon visible, then remove breadcrumbs, rebuild Debug+Release, run build-release.sh (universal), update result.md Iteration 6 with the TRUE root cause + evidence. Message main.

Constraints unchanged (no commit/push; user's GUI confirmation is the gate).

USER CONFIRMED WORKING (icon visible, app functional) — but before closing Iteration 6, user reported 3 new issues. Handle Iteration 6 cleanup + these 3 fixes as one final round:

## A. Close Iteration 6 (as promised)
Remove all breadcrumbs + crumb() helper + ~/jj-debug.log writes from AppDelegate; rebuild.

## B. User feedback fixes (requirement.md "Third Post-Phase-4 Batch")
1. **Hotkey settings: user can only record the TRANSLATE hotkey; the correct+translate recorder doesn't work.** Debug it: two HotkeyRecorderView instances — check first-responder acceptance (acceptsFirstResponder), click-to-focus, that both are wired to distinct store setters, and that keyDown reaches the focused one (not swallowed). Likely suspect: only the first recorder becomes first responder, or needsClicks/focus ring issues. Fix so BOTH record.
2. **Settings form fields cannot PASTE (URL/API key).** Root cause (Orchestrator-identified): LSUIElement app has NO main menu — AppKit text-editing shortcuts (⌘V/⌘C/⌘X/⌘A/⌘Z) are provided by the main menu's Edit menu. Fix: build a programmatic NSApp.mainMenu containing a standard Edit menu (Cut/Copy/Paste/SelectAll + undo/redo if cheap) — assign once at launch (harmless for menu bar app, invisible). Verify paste works in URL/Key/model/name fields after.
3. **Auto-copy result (NEW requirement):** when the result panel shows, automatically write the corrected text (or the translation when no correction) to the general pasteboard so the user can immediately paste at the target location. Keep the existing 复制 button (it can show "已复制" state immediately since it's already copied — adjust label/behavior accordingly, your judgment) and keep 替换原文 unchanged. Note the interplay: auto-copy happens at result display; 替换原文 later overwrites pasteboard with corrected text too — fine.

## C. Verify + close
- Self-check 7a–7g; Debug + Release green; run build-release.sh (universal), report artifact path.
- result.md: close Iteration 6 (root cause + evidence already drafted) + add Iteration 7 section (3 fixes).
- Kill the currently-running user instance is NOT your job (user will re-run themselves) — just build.
- Message main with summary. User will manually re-verify the 3 fixes.

USER ROUND-2 FEEDBACK — 3 items (requirement.md "Fourth Post-Phase-4 Batch" is the contract). Read it first.

## 1. Settings: "测试连接" (Test Connection) button
Provider form gets a test button that fires a minimal chat-completions request using the CURRENT form values (works even before save): POST with model + a tiny message (max_tokens minimal / "Reply with OK"). Inline result: 「✅ 连接成功（模型 X，耗时 Yms）」 or 「❌ 失败：<Chinese reason>」 — map common cases: unreachable URL, 401/403 (key invalid), 404 (URL/model path wrong), model-not-found message from API. Reuse AIClient (maybe add a lightweight `testConnection(provider:apiKey:)` method with its own short timeout ~10s). Disable button + spinner while testing.

## 2. Translate hotkey → INPUT WINDOW mode (interaction upgrade, reference Bob/Easydict)
⌥+D now opens a dedicated TranslationWindow instead of the capture-only flow:
- If text is selected at hotkey time → capture it, PRE-FILL the input field, and translate IMMEDIATELY (preserves the select-text experience)
- No selection → empty input, window focused for typing/pasting; user clicks 「翻译」 or presses Enter to translate
- Result appears below in the same window; keep auto-copy behavior; Esc closes; window reuses (like ResultPanel, don't recreate)
- ⌥+E (correct+translate) flow UNCHANGED (capture → floating panel)
- Design notes: regular focusable window (user needs to type), NSApp.activate to bring front (LSUIElement), reasonable default size (e.g. 420×360), text view for input (multi-line, scrollable), localized Chinese UI. Auto-translate on prefill only when capture succeeds.

## 3. BUG: settings hotkey section shows ONLY the translate recorder — the correct+translate recorder item is MISSING for the user
Your It7 focus fix did not solve the real problem. Root-cause properly this time: read SettingsWindowController layout code — is the second HotkeyRecorderView actually ADDED to the view hierarchy? Constraints conflicting/zero-height? Clipped by window frame? Verify at runtime: add a temporary accessibility/screenshot check or NSView dump of the settings window's view tree showing both recorders with frames. Fix root cause; both recorders must be visibly rendered with labels 「翻译」 and 「纠正+翻译」.

## Close out
- Self-check 7a–7g; Debug + Release green; run build-release.sh; result.md Iteration 8; message main.
- Constraints unchanged.

USER ROUND-3 FEEDBACK — Iteration 9 (requirement.md "Fifth Post-Phase-4 Batch"). Item 2 is the THIRD report of the same bug — three-strike rule in effect: evidence BEFORE fix this time, no more static-speculation patches.

## 1. One model succeeds, another shows 「AI 未返回任何内容」
Likely cause: reasoning models (user's mode.json flags supportsReasoning) return empty `choices[0].message.content` with the payload in `reasoning_content`, or finish_reason=length truncation. Fixes in AIClient:
- Decode optional `reasoning_content` on the message; when content is empty/whitespace, fall back to it.
- Send explicit reasonable max_tokens (e.g. 2048) on normal requests.
- If still empty: error message includes a truncated raw body snippet (~200 chars) so failures are diagnosable (「AI 未返回内容（原始返回: ...）」).
- testConnection benefits from same treatment.
- DO NOT guess further — if uncertain, add a temporary one-shot raw response dump (to Console/file) for the failing path, and reason from the actual payload shape. The user can reproduce with their 2nd provider config.

## 2. Correct+translate recorder STILL invisible (STRIKE 3 WARNING — evidence first)
It7 (focus) and It8 (auto-size frame) did not fix it for the user. Before ANY code change this round:
- Add a temporary dump in SettingsWindowController.windowDidLoad: recursiveDescription of contentView + window frame + fittingSize + each HotkeyRecorderView's frame AND superview chain → write to ~/jj-settings-dump.txt. Launch app (open -n), open settings programmatically if needed (temporary launch-argument trigger -openSettings), collect the dump. READ it. Identify from frames where the second recorder actually is (zero-height? off-window? never added? inside a clipped scroll view?).
- Fix the REAL cause found in the dump. Remove the dump + launch-arg trigger afterwards.
- If the dump shows both recorders correctly on-screen, then the user's report means something else (e.g. they see only ONE labeled section) — in that case message main with the dump interpretation BEFORE changing anything.

## 3. TranslationWindow UX fixes (4 sub-items)
a. Loading state never clears on several paths — audit ALL paths (capture failure, AI error, task cancelled, empty result) and guarantee status/UI reset in every exit branch (defer-style single exit point preferred).
b. Unwanted "capture" when nothing selected (cursor-position text gets ⌘C'd by some apps) — verify empty-selection path leaves input EMPTY; since target-app ⌘C behavior is beyond our control, make the prefill SOURCE visible: when prefilled from selection show a subtle line 「已获取选中文本（N 字）」+ the existing 清空 button must clear it; never silently translate text the user didn't select when the clipboard didn't change (double-check the changeCount logic — a target app that copies on ⌘C-without-selection DOES change count; we cannot distinguish — the visible-source line is the mitigation).
c. 「已自动复制」hint auto-fades after 3s (timer, cancel on reuse/dismiss).
d. Click-outside closes the TranslationWindow like the correct panel: global mouse monitor while visible; clicks inside window bounds exempt; Esc stays; reuse monitor install/remove pattern from ResultPanelController. Careful: window is focusable for typing — outside-click dismiss must not fight with text editing (dismiss only on mouseDown outside frame).

## Close out
Self-check 7a–7g, Debug+Release green, build-release.sh universal, result.md Iteration 9, message main. Constraints unchanged.

USER ROUND-4 FEEDBACK — Iteration 10 (requirement.md "Sixth Post-Phase-4 Batch" is the contract). All 5 items are TranslationWindow + capture quality.

## 1. 「已自动复制」 hint sometimes never fades (BUG)
Audit the fade-timer lifecycle: every status update must cancel the previous work item and restart the fade only for fade-eligible texts; window reuse/dismiss must cancel; rapid consecutive translates must not orphan a pending fade. Single helper: setStatus(_ text: String?, fades: Bool) — ALL status writes go through it.

## 2. Enter in input triggers translate (no button click)
NSTextView swallows plain Return. Reliable approach: make the window/contentView own a custom NSTextView subclass overriding keyDown (Return w/o option → translate; Shift+Return → newline) OR control(_:textView:doCommandBy:) with insertNewline. Pick one, verify both Return=translate and Shift+Return=newline work. Button stays as alternative.

## 3. Result area sometimes blank after translate (BUG)
Investigate the result-setting path in TranslationWindowController: main-thread ordering, empty-string early exit, and whether the reasoning_content fallback (added It9 in AIClient/PromptBuilder) actually covers THIS path (translate mode may parse differently). Reproduce mentally with: reasoning model + translate mode → corrected empty + translation from reasoning_content. Fix; ensure result rendering handles empty-corrected (translate-only) display robustly.

## 4. Reopen without selection → RETAIN last input + result (INTERACTION CHANGE — supersedes last round's force-clear)
When hotkey pressed and NO selection captured → do NOT clear; show previous input + result (user may want to re-read). Focus the input (caret at end) for immediate retyping; typing replaces naturally. When selection IS captured → prefill + auto-translate as now (overwrites). 清空 button still resets everything.

## 5. Cursor-in-text (no selection) wrongly captures nearby text (ROOT FIX — mainstream approach)
Upgrade TextCaptureService to AX-first capture (like Bob/Easydict):
- First: query the system-wide focused UI element via Accessibility API (AXUIElementCopyElementAtPoint or focused element → kAXSelectedTextAttribute / kAXSelectedTextRangeAttribute). Non-empty selected text → return it directly (NO clipboard touch, no synthetic ⌘C at all).
- Empty selected text → treat as NO selection (manual input mode; never simulate ⌘C). This kills the cursor-word/line-copy behavior of editors.
- Only if the AX query itself errors/is unavailable (edge apps) → fall back to the existing snapshot+⌘C+changeCount flow.
- Requires the accessibility permission we already gate on. Apply to BOTH ⌥D (translate window) and ⌥E (correct flow) capture paths.
